title: 第202章 要不，嫂子再帮帮你？
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“大壮，姐爱你~~”

人在掏心掏肺的剖白自己后，往往内心是最空虚的，就像此时的程露思，早就没了平时端庄的模样，彻底放开了……

李大壮用行动回应着程露思，火热的嘴唇挪到了程露思雪白脖颈下面的位置……

“嗯~~~”

程露思娇躯瞬间颤抖起来，浑身软的站不住，红唇微微张开，娇喘着发出一声声妩媚的渴望！

李大壮也亵玩到了他想要的……

确实很好玩！

关键是软啊，软的人心神荡漾，几乎把握不住……

李大壮忍不了了，他决定大干一场，可姜舒盈却随时可能回来！

“姐，要不去你办公室？”

“不，我一刻也等不了了！”程露思用力抱着李大壮，极度的空虚让她什么都顾不上了，娇喘着说：“大不了我们就快一点嘛~~”

“我快不了啊！”李大壮有些无语。

“那也没关系，这次的会议是高层会，说的都是重要的事，嫂子也会在这个会议上通知大家跟你合作的事情，开会时间很长的，也许要两个小时！”

“时间够用的~”

程露思撒娇似的在李大壮怀里蹭了蹭，李大壮哪里还能受得了，当即把她按倒在了沙发上！

“那你要忍着点，第一次，会疼的！”李大壮哑声提醒。

“嗯~”程露思脸蛋儿红的像熟透的樱桃，娇俏可爱，让人很想咬一口！

“露思姐，你真香！”

“臭小子~你好坏~”程露思被李大壮咬的娇躯一颤，身子更软了，美眸里春水荡漾，仿佛快要溢出来了……

李大壮哪里还能受得住，不再忍耐……

“嗯~大壮~”程露思颤抖着抱紧李大壮宽阔的后背，让人眩晕的男性荷尔蒙，正随着她的娇喘，霸道凶猛的钻进她小巧的鼻腔，在一整条呼吸道和胸腔里冲撞着……

不过李大壮也不没只顾着自己享受，做足了功夫，让程露思彻底放松下来，虽然是第一次经历这种事，但也没让她太受罪，甚至很快就尝到了其中的乐趣！

…………

虽然程露思说姜舒盈要开两个小时的会，但李大壮也没敢太放肆，而且因为是在姜舒盈办公室里，比较刺激，所以四五十分钟就收了神通！

但这个时间，也够程露思喝一壶的了……

Page (1/3)

"Da Zhuang, sister loves you~~"

After people confess their hearts and souls, they often feel the emptiest inside. Just like Cheng Lusi at this time, she has long lost her usual dignified appearance and completely let go...

Li Dazhuang responded to Cheng Lusi with actions, and his hot lips moved to the bottom of Cheng Lusi's white neck...

"Hmm~~~"

Cheng Lusi's delicate body trembled instantly, and she was so weak that she couldn't stand. Her red lips opened slightly, and she gasped and let out charming longing sounds!

Li Dazhuang also got what he wanted...

It's really fun!

The key is to be soft. A soft person's heart is full of emotions and can hardly be grasped...

Li Dazhuang couldn't bear it anymore and decided to fight, but Jiang Shuying might come back at any time!

"Sister, why don't you go to your office?"

"No, I can't wait any longer!" Cheng Lusi hugged Li Dazhuang with all her strength. The extreme emptiness made her unable to care about anything. She gasped and said, "At worst, we should hurry up~~"

"I can't move faster!" Li Dazhuang was speechless.

"That's okay. This meeting is a high-level meeting. All important things are discussed. My sister-in-law will also inform everyone about cooperating with you at this meeting. The meeting will take a long time, maybe two hours!"

“There’s enough time~”

Cheng Lusi nuzzled into Li Dazhuang's arms like a baby. Li Dazhuang couldn't stand it anymore and immediately pushed her down on the sofa!

"Then you have to be patient. It will hurt for the first time!" Li Dazhuang reminded hoarsely.

"Hmm~" Cheng Lusi's face was as red as a ripe cherry, so cute and cute that it made people want to take a bite!

"Sister Ruth, you smell so good!"

"Bad boy~How are you~" Cheng Lusi's delicate body trembled when she was bitten by Li Dazhuang, and her body became softer. The spring water in her beautiful eyes was rippling, as if it was about to overflow...

How can Li Dazhuang endure it anymore? He can no longer bear it...

"Hmm~ Dazhuang~" Cheng Lusi tremblingly hugged Li Dazhuang's broad back. The dizzying male hormones, following her gasping, entered her small nasal cavity domineeringly and fiercely, rushing through the entire respiratory tract and chest...

However, Li Dazhuang didn't just care about his own enjoyment, and worked hard to make Cheng Lusi relax completely. Although it was the first time to experience this kind of thing, he didn't make her suffer too much, and she even tasted the fun very quickly!

…………

Although Cheng Lusi said that Jiang Shuying would have a two-hour meeting, Li Dazhuang did not dare to be too presumptuous, and because it was in Jiang Shuying's office, it was more exciting, so he stopped using his magical powers in forty or fifty minutes!

But this time is enough for Cheng Lusi to drink a pot...
